		// Get clean path (remove /main prefix if present)
		const path = window.location.pathname;
		const cleanPath = path.startsWith('/main/') ? path.replace(/^\/main/, '') : path;

		// Page Type 1 Classification
		const getPageType1 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'blog' },
				{ paths: ['/company', '/careers'], type: 'company' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/legal-document-centre', '/privacy-policy', '/platform-and-services-privacy-policy',
						'/website-and-platform-user-privacy-policy', '/cookie-policy',
						'/opt-out-of-sale-targeted-advertising'
					],
					type: 'legal'
				},
				{
					paths: [
						'/admin', '/account', '/oauth_client', '/universal-pixel', '/audiences',
						'/overview', '/qa-page2', '/login/sso', '/auth', '/editor', '/reporting'
					],
					type: 'Platform'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'core site';
		};

		const pageType1 = getPageType1(cleanPath);

		// Page Type 2 Classification
		const getPageType2 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources/blog'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources > Blog' },
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources' },
				{ paths: ['/industry-solutions'], type: 'Marketing Site > Industry Solutions' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/native-advertising', '/display-advertising', '/video-advertising',
						'/connected-tv-advertising', '/programmatic-audio-advertising',
						'/in-game-advertising', '/digital-out-of-home-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Marketing Site > Channel Pages'
				},
				{ paths: ['/company', '/news', '/careers'], type: 'Company > Careers' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/privacy-policy', '/legal-document-centre', '/cookie-policy',
						'/opt-out-of-sale-targeted-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Company > Legal'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'Marketing Site > Other';
		};

		const pageType2 = getPageType2(cleanPath);

		// Author & Publish Date & Content Category
		let author = '';
		let publishDate = '';
		let contentCategory = '';

		
		// Content Type
		const getContentType = (cleanPath) => {
			const contentTypeMap = {
				'/resources/blog': 'blog',
				'/resources/webinars': 'webinars',
				'/resources/downloads': 'downloads',
				'/resources/podcast': 'podcast'
			};

			for (const [path, type] of Object.entries(contentTypeMap)) {
				if (cleanPath.startsWith(path)) {
					return type;
				}
			}

		// Get clean path (remove /main prefix if present)
		const path = window.location.pathname;
		const cleanPath = path.startsWith('/main/') ? path.replace(/^\/main/, '') : path;

		// Page Type 1 Classification
		const getPageType1 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'blog' },
				{ paths: ['/company', '/careers'], type: 'company' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/legal-document-centre', '/privacy-policy', '/platform-and-services-privacy-policy',
						'/website-and-platform-user-privacy-policy', '/cookie-policy',
						'/opt-out-of-sale-targeted-advertising'
					],
					type: 'legal'
				},
				{
					paths: [
						'/admin', '/account', '/oauth_client', '/universal-pixel', '/audiences',
						'/overview', '/qa-page2', '/login/sso', '/auth', '/editor', '/reporting'
					],
					type: 'Platform'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'core site';
		};

		const pageType1 = getPageType1(cleanPath);

		// Page Type 2 Classification
		const getPageType2 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources/blog'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources > Blog' },
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources' },
				{ paths: ['/industry-solutions'], type: 'Marketing Site > Industry Solutions' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/native-advertising', '/display-advertising', '/video-advertising',
						'/connected-tv-advertising', '/programmatic-audio-advertising',
						'/in-game-advertising', '/digital-out-of-home-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Marketing Site > Channel Pages'
				},
				{ paths: ['/company', '/news', '/careers'], type: 'Company > Careers' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/privacy-policy', '/legal-document-centre', '/cookie-policy',
						'/opt-out-of-sale-targeted-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Company > Legal'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'Marketing Site > Other';
		};

		const pageType2 = getPageType2(cleanPath);

		// Author & Publish Date & Content Category
		let author = '';
		let publishDate = '';
		let contentCategory = '';

		
		// Content Type
		const getContentType = (cleanPath) => {
			const contentTypeMap = {
				'/resources/blog': 'blog',
				'/resources/webinars': 'webinars',
				'/resources/downloads': 'downloads',
				'/resources/podcast': 'podcast'
			};

			for (const [path, type] of Object.entries(contentTypeMap)) {
				if (cleanPath.startsWith(path)) {
					return type;
				}
			}
			return '';
		};

		const contentType = getContentType(cleanPath);

		// Tags
		
		window.datalayerPageviewVariables = {
			event: 'pageview',
			page_type: pageType1,
			page_type2: pageType2,
			author: author,
			publish_date: publishDate,
			content_category: contentCategory,
			content_type: contentType,
					};

		// Push pageview immediately — page classification data requires no consent gating

		// Get clean path (remove /main prefix if present)
		const path = window.location.pathname;
		const cleanPath = path.startsWith('/main/') ? path.replace(/^\/main/, '') : path;

		// Page Type 1 Classification
		const getPageType1 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'blog' },
				{ paths: ['/company', '/careers'], type: 'company' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/legal-document-centre', '/privacy-policy', '/platform-and-services-privacy-policy',

					],
					type: 'legal'
				},
				{
					paths: [
						'/admin', '/account', '/oauth_client', '/universal-pixel', '/audiences',
						'/overview', '/qa-page2', '/login/sso', '/auth', '/editor', '/reporting'
					],
					type: 'Platform'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'core site';
		};

		const pageType1 = getPageType1(cleanPath);

		// Page Type 2 Classification
		const getPageType2 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources/blog'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources > Blog' },
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources' },
				{ paths: ['/industry-solutions'], type: 'Marketing Site > Industry Solutions' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/native-advertising', '/display-advertising', '/video-advertising',
						'/connected-tv-advertising', '/programmatic-audio-advertising',
						'/in-game-advertising', '/digital-out-of-home-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Marketing Site > Channel Pages'
				},
				{ paths: ['/company', '/news', '/careers'], type: 'Company > Careers' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/privacy-policy', '/legal-document-centre', '/cookie-policy',
						'/opt-out-of-sale-targeted-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Company > Legal'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'Marketing Site > Other';
		};

		const pageType2 = getPageType2(cleanPath);

		// Author & Publish Date & Content Category
		let author = '';
		let publishDate = '';
		let contentCategory = '';

		
		// Content Type
		const getContentType = (cleanPath) => {
			const contentTypeMap = {
				'/resources/blog': 'blog',
				'/resources/webinars': 'webinars',
				'/resources/downloads': 'downloads',
				'/resources/podcast': 'podcast'
			};

			for (const [path, type] of Object.entries(contentTypeMap)) {
				if (cleanPath.startsWith(path)) {
					return type;
				}
			}
			return '';
		};

		const contentType = getContentType(cleanPath);

					};

Ready to get started? Launch independently today or connect with our team of experts. Request a Demo Sign Up FAQs How does DSP pricing typically work? Most DSPs charge a percentage of media spend as a platform fee. At StackAdapt, there are no hidden tech fees, and clients can choose self-serve, managed, or hybrid support models depending on their needs. What monthly budget is recommended to see meaningful results? Programmatic ad campaigns perform best when they have enough budget to generate meaningful scale. That typically means allocating enough investment to test the audience, run across multiple channels, and optimize in flight. Do I need programmatic experience to run campaigns? No, you don’t need programmatic experience to run campaigns on StackAdapt. The platform is built to be intuitive, user-friendly, even for those new to programmatic.  We provide onboarding support, forecasting tools, and built-in AI recommendations to guide setup and optimization. And if you want strategic support, you can move into a hybrid or managed model as you’re never locked into self-serve. What happens if I choose a self-serve model, but later need support? You’re never locked into one level of support with StackAdapt. Many clients start self-serve to get hands-on with the platform, then transition into a more strategic partnership as their campaigns and needs scale.  As your needs evolve, we can layer in managed services, such as advanced targeting, creative support, cross-channel orchestration, or advanced reporting. StackAdapt is designed to grow with you, from agile self-serve execution to a fully supported partnership. Should I choose self-serve or managed partnership? jsonld_parsed.description: The AI platform for every stage of advertising

jsonld_parsed.name: How does DSP pricing typically work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most DSPs charge a percentage of media spend as a platform fee. At StackAdapt, there are no hidden tech fees, and clients can choose self-serve, managed, or hybrid support models depending on their needs.

jsonld_parsed.name: What monthly budget is recommended to see meaningful results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Programmatic ad campaigns perform best when they have enough budget to generate meaningful scale. That typically means allocating enough investment to test the audience, run across multiple channels, and optimize in flight.

jsonld_parsed.name: Do I need programmatic experience to run campaigns?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you don’t need programmatic experience to run campaigns on StackAdapt. The platform is built to be intuitive, user-friendly, even for those new to programmatic. We provide onboarding support, forecasting tools, and built-in AI recommendations to guide setup and optimization. And if you want strategic support, you can move into a hybrid or managed model as you’re never locked into self-serve.

jsonld_parsed.name: What happens if I choose a self-serve model, but later need support?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’re never locked into one level of support with StackAdapt. Many clients start self-serve to get hands-on with the platform, then transition into a more strategic partnership as their campaigns and needs scale. As your needs evolve, we can layer in managed services, such as advanced targeting, creative support, cross-channel orchestration, or advanced reporting. StackAdapt is designed to grow with you, from agile self-serve execution to a fully supported partnership.

jsonld_parsed.name: Should I choose self-serve or managed partnership?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on how your team prefers to work. Some customers run campaigns fully self-serve, while others collaborate with our experts. Many move between both as their campaigns scale. It all comes down to your needs.

		// Get clean path (remove /main prefix if present)
		const path = window.location.pathname;
		const cleanPath = path.startsWith('/main/') ? path.replace(/^\/main/, '') : path;

		// Page Type 1 Classification
		const getPageType1 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'blog' },
				{ paths: ['/company', '/careers'], type: 'company' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/legal-document-centre', '/privacy-policy', '/platform-and-services-privacy-policy',
						'/website-and-platform-user-privacy-policy', '/cookie-policy',
						'/opt-out-of-sale-targeted-advertising'
					],
					type: 'legal'
				},
				{
					paths: [
						'/admin', '/account', '/oauth_client', '/universal-pixel', '/audiences',
						'/overview', '/qa-page2', '/login/sso', '/auth', '/editor', '/reporting'
					],
					type: 'Platform'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'core site';
		};

		const pageType1 = getPageType1(cleanPath);

		// Page Type 2 Classification
		const getPageType2 = (cleanPath) => {
			// Define page type mappings with priority order (most specific first)
			const pageTypeMap = [
				{ paths: ['/resources/blog'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources > Blog' },
				{ paths: ['/resources'], type: 'Marketing Site > Resources' },
				{ paths: ['/industry-solutions'], type: 'Marketing Site > Industry Solutions' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/native-advertising', '/display-advertising', '/video-advertising',
						'/connected-tv-advertising', '/programmatic-audio-advertising',
						'/in-game-advertising', '/digital-out-of-home-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Marketing Site > Channel Pages'
				},
				{ paths: ['/company', '/news', '/careers'], type: 'Company > Careers' },
				{
					paths: [
						'/privacy-policy', '/legal-document-centre', '/cookie-policy',
						'/opt-out-of-sale-targeted-advertising'
					],
					type: 'Company > Legal'
				}
			];

			// Find matching page type
			for (const { paths, type } of pageTypeMap) {
				if (paths.some(p => cleanPath.startsWith(p))) {
					return type;
				}
			}

			return 'Marketing Site > Other';
		};

		const pageType2 = getPageType2(cleanPath);

		// Author & Publish Date & Content Category
		let author = '';
		let publishDate = '';
		let contentCategory = '';

		
		// Content Type
		const getContentType = (cleanPath) => {
			const contentTypeMap = {
				'/resources/blog': 'blog',
				'/resources/webinars': 'webinars',
				'/resources/downloads': 'downloads',
				'/resources/podcast': 'podcast'
			};

			for (const [path, type] of Object.entries(contentTypeMap)) {
				if (cleanPath.startsWith(path)) {
					return type;
				}
			}
			return '';
		};

		const contentType = getContentType(cleanPath);

		// Tags
		
		window.datalayerPageviewVariables = {
			event: 'pageview',
			page_type: pageType1,

			author: author,

					};

Our work in machine learning and data science sets us apart. It helps us understand the complexity of human behavior, master the art of problem solving, and invent technology to revolutionize how brands reach consumers. Our story StackAdapt was born out of a passion for science and entrepreneurial aspirations. Our Leadership Principles shape our culture and set the standard for what great leadership should be.
